payload.rebuttal: argued: The spec's own "Out of scope" section names this exactly: "The v0.5 phase. A ledger migration backfills one attempt per legacy gate result in phase v0.5, started at migration time... The rule reads it as a cell attempt. The ledger copy holds no such row, so no witness drives it." The spec explicitly tells the implementer not to guard against this and not to add a witness for it, since the measured ledger holds no such row. Adding an exclusion now would be untested behavior the task was told to leave alone; the risk is real for a different deployment's ledger but is the spec author's own documented call, to be revisited when it actually bites (as b-946f03 already anticipates).
